country: United States: Arizona, Virginia and Minnesota
value: A landlord may not demand or receive security, including prepaid rent, of more than one and one-half month's rent; a tenant may still voluntarily pay more rent in advance (A.R.S. § 33-1321(A)).
note: Official online statute texts of the Arizona Legislature, Virginia General Assembly (LIS) and Minnesota Office of the Revisor of Statutes, as read on the check date; later amendments are not included.

country: United States: Arizona, Virginia and Minnesota
value: The purpose of every nonrefundable fee or deposit must be stated in writing; any fee or deposit not designated nonrefundable is refundable (A.R.S. § 33-1321(B)).
note: Official online statute texts of the Arizona Legislature, Virginia General Assembly (LIS) and Minnesota Office of the Revisor of Statutes, as read on the check date; later amendments are not included.

country: United States: Arizona, Virginia and Minnesota
value: On move-in the landlord must give the tenant a signed copy of the lease, a move-in form for listing existing damage, and written notice that the tenant may be present at the move-out inspection (A.R.S. § 33-1321(C)).
note: Official online statute texts of the Arizona Legislature, Virginia General Assembly (LIS) and Minnesota Office of the Revisor of Statutes, as read on the check date; later amendments are not included.

country: United States: Arizona, Virginia and Minnesota
value: Within fourteen days, excluding Saturdays, Sundays and legal holidays, after the tenancy ends, possession is delivered and the tenant demands it, the landlord must give an itemized list of deductions with any amount due; wrongful withholding allows recovery of twice the amount withheld (A.R.S. § 33-1321(D)-(E)).
note: Official online statute texts of the Arizona Legislature, Virginia General Assembly (LIS) and Minnesota Office of the Revisor of Statutes, as read on the check date; later amendments are not included.

country: United States: Arizona, Virginia and Minnesota
value: A landlord may not demand or receive a security deposit of more than two months' periodic rent (Va. Code § 55.1-1226(A)).
note: Official online statute texts of the Arizona Legislature, Virginia General Assembly (LIS) and Minnesota Office of the Revisor of Statutes, as read on the check date; later amendments are not included.

country: United States: Arizona, Virginia and Minnesota
value: The deposit and any itemized deductions must be set out in a written notice to the tenant, with any amount due, within 45 days after the tenancy ends or the tenant vacates, whichever is later (Va. Code § 55.1-1226(A)).
note: Official online statute texts of the Arizona Legislature, Virginia General Assembly (LIS) and Minnesota Office of the Revisor of Statutes, as read on the check date; later amendments are not included.

country: United States: Arizona, Virginia and Minnesota
value: A residential deposit bears simple noncompounded interest of one percent per year, payable to the tenant (Minn. Stat. § 504B.178, subd. 2).
source_publisher: Minnesota Office of the Revisor of Statutes

value: Within three weeks after the tenancy ends (five days after leaving a legally condemned building not due to the tenant), and after receiving the tenant's mailing address, the landlord must return the deposit with interest or give a written statement of the specific reasons for withholding (Minn. Stat. § 504B.178, subd. 3).
